svg.title: Seal5 passes, order and scope
svg.desc: All registered passes in execution order, with model/global scopes and nested PatternGen expansion.
svg.text: Seal5 passes: execution order and scope
Read T01–T38, then G01–G11, then the expanded G12 pipeline P01–P04.
M = once per input model G = once globally * = conditional / opt-in
Default wrapper: G01–G11 run before phases 1–2 are applied; G12 runs after PatternGen / llc are built.
Order follows the registered lists, not Seal5Pass.order. Passes are serial; model instances may run concurrently.
All transforms and P01–P04 have MODEL scope. Four generators have GLOBAL scope. INSTR scope is not implemented;
SET is marked unsupported in the API and is not used by any registered pass. Splitting files per instruction does not change scope.
* T33–T36 require enabled=true; G01 needs a GNU source tree. Filters and PatternGen eligibility can skip additional work.
gen_model_td is an available handler but is not registered; it has no default execution position (MODEL, phase 1).
Source: seal5/flow.py (pass maps + create_passes) · seal5/passes.py · seal5/pass_list.py (pattern_gen_pass)
